info.title: Transport for London Universal API
info.description: Access Transport for London open data, including live line status, journey planning, stop points, arrivals, roads, bike points, places, occupancy, and search data from the TfL Unified API.

get.description: Retrieves a bike point from Transport for London.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: Bike point ID, such as BikePoints_1.

parameters.name: fields
